basic_details.job_title: Jharkhand Finance Department Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Program Director, Additional Program Director Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Finance Department, Government of Jharkhand (Jharkhand Sarkar, Vitt Vibhag) is engaging one Program Director and one Additional Program Director on contract to strengthen its Project Management Unit (PMU), with a salary of Rs. 2 Lakh and Rs. 1.5 Lakh a month respectively plus a gross allowance of Rs. 1.5 Lakh and Rs. 0.75 Lakh a month. The posts need a B.Tech./B.E. (Computer Science/IT) or M.C.A and a minimum of 10 years (Program Director) or 7 years (Additional Program Director) of senior management experience, and the engagement is for 05 years or until the age of 65, whichever comes fir

selection_process: on the basis of the applications received by the Department
by a high-level selection committee chaired by the Development Commissioner. The selected candidate will be engaged on contract by the Department on the committee's recommendation. The committee is:
Jharkhand – Chairperson Additional Chief Secretary/Principal Secretary/Secretary
Jharkhand – Member Additional Chief Secretary/Principal Secretary/Secretary
how_to_apply: Go to the JAP-IT Online Recruitment Portal, https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in.
Fill in the online application there.
Scan and upload copies of the applicable certificates listed below with the application.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 online through the Payment Gateway on the JAPIT Recruitment Portal.
Submit the application on or before 25 December 2026; no application will be accepted after the last date, and applications by any other mode will not be accepted.
Certificates of desirable educational qualification and other qualifications, issued by an authorised institution/competent level.
Work experience certificates issued by the competent level.

The prescribed application format printed with the notice also asks for the post name, name, gender, father's/husband's name, mother's name, date of birth, identification mark, permanent and correspondence addresses, mobile number, e-mail ID, educational and desirable qualification details, work experience certificates, category (General/Backward Class/Extremely Backward Class/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe) with the certificate's letter number and date, a passport-size photograph and the applicant's signature. It ends with a declaration that no case is registered against the applicant at any police station and that the applicant has not been convicted in any criminal case; any information found false at any stage may lead to cancellation of candidature.
important_instructions: Information about the appointment will be published on the JAP-IT Online Recruitment Portal and in leading newspapers. No TA/DA will be admissible to candidates attending the interview. If any error made unknowingly during selection comes to the Department's notice at any stage, even after the appointment letter is issued, the Finance Department reserves the right to revise, withdraw or cancel the selection. In any dispute or ambiguity in the selection process, the decision of the Finance Department will be final. No correspondence will be entertained about the shortlisting of applications, selection or the reasons for not being called for interview.

content_sections.heading: About Jharkhand Finance Department
content_sections.text: The Finance Department of the Government of Jharkhand, Ranchi, runs a Project Management Unit (PMU) for its IT projects. The notice invites highly skilled technical professionals to be engaged on contract as technical expert officers to strengthen this PMU.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Finance Department reserves the right to increase or reduce the number of posts and to cancel the advertised vacancies as required.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification and the desirable qualification are the same for both posts; only the length of experience differs. Essential Qualification (both posts): B.Tech. (Computer Science/IT)/B.E. (Computer Science/IT)/M.C.A from Government recognized University/Institute. Desirable Qualification (both posts): MBA/PGDBM from Government recognized University/Institute. A Senior Management Officer from CMMI Level 5/Forbes Global 2000 Company/Indian Unicorn Company or Government Organization with an experience for minimum 10 years in relevant field. A Senior Management Officer from CMMI Level 5/Forbes Global 2000 Company/Indian Unicorn Company or Government Organization with an experience for minimum 7 years in relevant field. The job summary for both posts adds that experience in Finance Management and the Financial Service Delivery Domain in the Government would be an added advantage, and that a good knowledge of English is expected. The candidate must hold the qualification, eligibility and experience fixed by the Finance Department. The notice does not mention a minimum or maximum age for applying; the engagement itself runs only until the age of 65. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The gross allowance includes Transport Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Medical Allowance etc. These figures apply to new personnel. For employees retired from the Government of India or a State Government who are re-engaged on contract in these posts, the fixed pay is set as follows: A fixed monthly honorarium/pay equal to the last basic pay drawn at retirement minus the basic pension. No dearness allowance or annual increment on this fixed pay. Pension and dearness relief continue to be paid as per rules. If no government accommodation is allotted, 75 percent of the House Rent Allowance admissible for Ranchi city, based on the pay at retirement. If no government vehicle is provided, Transport Allowance as per the Pay Level held at retirement (where admissible, with the dearness allowance due on the date of retirement); no increase in Transport Allowance with a rise in dearness allowance. The engagement is on contract. Selected officers will be engaged for 05 (five) years or until reaching 65 years of age, whichever comes first. Depending on departmental need and satisfactory work, the term may be extended by 3 years at a time (until age 65) with the approval of the Departmental Minister. No government accommodation will be provided. The engagement gives no claim to adjustment against any post in the government. EPF contribution will be deducted on the basis of the wage ceiling limit under the EPF Act, 1952. Travel allowance for official travel: Program Director as a Joint Secretary (Pay Level- 13) and Additional Program Director as a Deputy Secretary (Pay Level- 12) of the Government of Jharkhand. 14 days of casual leave per year and compensatory leave as admissible to state employees. After successfully completing 01 (one) year, an Annual Increment at 8 percent of the salary at the start of each subsequent year.

content_sections.heading: Jharkhand Finance Department Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same Job Summary and Distinguishing Characteristics for both posts. Job Summary: deep knowledge of Government Policies, Procedures, Processes, Standards and Guidelines; understanding of Technology, Quality Standards, Information Systems' internal controls framework, Software Engineering and business processes. Ability to analyse, derive feasibility and foresee requirements as per Government needs. Proficiency in developing mechanism for implementation of IT, Project Management, works monitoring; deep knowledge of SDLC, software development environment, IT Infrastructure, Server Management and Change Management. Ability to formulate Policies, Procedures, Processes, Guidelines, Standards and Standard Operating Procedures; good leadership, initiative, communication, presentation and other soft skills. Distinguishing Characteristics: preparation of future plan, enhancement in existing system, detailed scopes and objectives for computer programs for administration, management, control and other operations. Preparation and finalisation of RFP, vendor management and other project lifecycle works; managing the budget and finances of Project(s) and the PMU; implementation, monitoring, review, follow-ups and support of plans. Carrying out feasibility studies of proposals and making recommendations for formulation of Policy, Procedures, Processes, Guidelines and Standards and to get approval from the competent level. Ensuring timely and within budget planning and development under the Agile methodology, Configuration Management of IT systems, Change Management and Quality Assurance. Interaction with the Development Team to understand software limitations, resolving their problems, ensure testing for quality of software and deployment of the completed software. To ensure quality and timeliness of the project and to ensure post implementation support. Shall be accountable for efficient and effective functioning and operation of Project Management Unit. Shall ensure Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of the Information System. Coordination within various wings of the department/government, understanding their needs and suggest actions thereon. Monitoring the server management and to ensure robust internal control framework and IT Security. To monitor and ensure implementation of the project and to report it to the next level. To ensure helpdesk and support systems are working efficiently and effectively. To make presentations before different stakeholders and to conduct training programs. To ensure statutory compliance and compliance of IT Audit/ other global standards. Works assigned by the Department from time to time. To assist the Program Director and/or the Department in the following works: Carrying out feasibility studies of proposals and making recommendations for formulation of Policy, Procedures, Processes, Guidelines and Standards and to get approval from the competent level. Ensuring timely and within budget planning

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Jharkhand Finance Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Program Director and 1 Additional Program Director in the Project Management Unit of the Finance Department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 25 December 2026, and no application will be accepted after it.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Program Director and Additional Program Director posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need a B.Tech. (Computer Science/IT)/B.E. (Computer Science/IT)/M.C.A from a Government recognized University/Institute, with MBA/PGDBM as a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: A minimum of 10 years for Program Director and 7 years for Additional Program Director in a relevant field, as a Senior Management Officer from a CMMI Level 5/Forbes Global 2000 Company/Indian Unicorn Company or Government Organization.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Program Director and Additional Program Director?
faq.answer: The Program Director gets a salary of Rs. 2 Lakh a month plus a gross allowance of Rs. 1.5 Lakh, and the Additional Program Director gets Rs. 1.5 Lakh plus Rs. 0.75 Lakh; the allowance includes Transport, House Rent and Medical Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100, paid online through the Payment Gateway on the JAPIT Recruitment Portal.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on the JAP-IT Online Recruitment Portal (https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in) and upload scanned copies of your matriculation, qualification and work experience certificates; other modes are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be interviewed by a high-level selection committee chaired by the Development Commissioner, Jharkhand, and the selected candidate will be engaged on contract on its recommendation.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent, and for how long is the contract?
faq.answer: The job is on contract for 05 years or until age 65, whichever comes first, and may be extended by 3 years at a time (up to 65) with the Departmental Minister's approval; it gives no claim to a government post.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any annual increment?
faq.answer: Yes. After successfully completing one year, an Annual Increment at 8 percent of the salary is admissible at the start of each subsequent year.
